title: Live2.ai Raises ₹130 Cr To Scale AI Marketing SaaS Platform
script:
Live2.ai just raised 130 crore rupees for its AI marketing platform.
This pre-Series B round is led by IvyCap Ventures.
The Bengaluru startup uses AI to automate marketing workflows for brands.
That 130 crore investment is worth 13.7 million dollars.
The company will use this cash to scale its SaaS product features.
They also plan to strengthen their presence in international markets.
Would you trust AI to manage your brand marketing?
